sourceText:
When I started my consulting business, one thing frustrated me more than I expected.

Not the work itself.

The amount of time spent before a real conversation could even begin.

Searching online.
Opening websites.
Checking if businesses were relevant.
Trying to find emails and phone numbers.
Building contact lists manually.

Hours disappearing into research instead of actual business development.

That frustration is one of the reasons I built ALPA.

A tool designed to help professional service businesses find filtered business leads in seconds, with website, email, and phone included.

The idea is simple:

Spend less time searching and more time having conversations that move your business forward.

If this sounds familiar, you can try it here:

https://alpa.mindrasolutions.com
